carbon.description: View-scoped Carbon assumptions; same shape as the Carbon controls.

details.grid: Key from the shared carbon factors grids, or custom with nonnegative customGrid in g CO2e/kWh.

parallelism.description: Ribbon mode, counting, gap, repository, range/custom bounds, selected workspace/agent, zoom and smoothingMinutes.

targets.description: A registered view field or control wrapper.
Chart control identified by its lower-case accessible label, with spaces replaced by hyphens (metric, breakdown, scale).
A named section (its stable HTML ID).
Card definition ID from browse_site cards. Does not change the card filters.
Message ID; materializes the message and opens its ancestors.
Tool-call ID; reveals its owning message.
Conversation/session ID in the delegation explorer.
Stable record ID in the current query result. Does not broaden filters.

Reveal an exact record/property/JSONPath via Query Table: detail:{"rowId":"id","field":"arguments_json","path":"$[\"events\"][21]"}. field/path are optional; preserve numeric versus string IDs. The page selects the dataset. Loads exact details without changing filters or pagination; disabled/absent properties are unavailable. This family supports reveal only.
Literal text search. Opens a prefilled Find box, highlights matches and reveals the first. No browser focus movement.

attention.reveal: One landing target; scroll and distinctive highlight, never browser focus

excluded.settings: Settings values and their read-only diagnostics; section openness uses disclosures.
excluded.legacy: Legacy Analyze/Tools controls are deferred; canonical pages cannot inherit this exclusion.
excluded.transient: Hover, keyboard focus, menu openness, scroll offsets and automatic animation progress.
excluded.editing: Unapplied drafts, editing and mutation/export/refresh actions. Applied searches are included.

query_table_json_cells.reason: Native property JSON is portable. JSON display cells created by DataTable still do not receive scoped controlled inspection state; requires a published upstream integration.

query_table_attention.reason: Exact record/property/JSONPath reveal is integrated. The public API does not support highlight-only, multiple persistent semantic targets, or clearing/replacing prior property marks. detail: is reveal-only; existing host highlights remain supported.

paths: Nodes are addressed by path. An option is <node>/<option name>; a filter field is <node>/filters/<field>, taken from the node's dataset. A card is cards/<id>.

human_input.label: Estimated human text tokens
human_input.note: Estimated tokens of human-supplied text, including pasted material; these are not authored word counts.

output.label: Recorded output tokens
output.note: Recorded model output attributed to each conversation.

messages.label: Human messages
messages.note: Human messages recorded in conversation activity.

conversation.label: Whole conversation
conversation.note: A top-level conversation includes its attributed delegated activity. Only activity in the selected range counts.

typed.label: Typed words
typed.note: Typed words are text you typed or dictated; pastes, copied agent output, templates, attachments, harness instructions and automated prompts are counted separately.

words.label: All user words
words.note: All user words count every word of each classified user message, whatever its source; Text source splits them.

typed_messages.label: Messages with typed text
typed_messages.note: Messages holding at least one typed or dictated word.

messages.label: User messages
messages.note: Every classified user message, including those holding only supplied text.

conversations.label: Conversations
conversations.note: Distinct conversations with a matching message. A conversation in several groups counts once in each, so groups do not add up to the total.

typed_share.label: Typed share of words
typed_share.note: Typed words divided by all user words, pooled over each group's messages rather than averaging per-message shares.

words_per_message.label: Typed words per message
words_per_message.note: Typed words divided by messages holding any, pooled; messages without typed text do not dilute it.

correction_share.label: Correction-cue share
correction_share.note: Messages whose typed text holds a correction cue (the dataset's own rule), divided by all messages, pooled.

positive_share.label: Positive-cue share
positive_share.note: Messages whose typed text holds a positive cue (the dataset's own rule), divided by all messages, pooled.

copied_share.label: Copied-from-conversation share
copied_share.note: Messages holding text matched to an earlier conversation, divided by all messages, pooled.

provider.label: Provider
provider.note: Each message counts under its own conversation's provider, not its work's combined providers.

channel.label: Channel
channel.note: Each message counts under its own conversation's channel, not its work's combined channels.

machine_id.label: Machine
machine_id.note: Each message counts under its own conversation's machine, not its work's combined machines.

execution_machine_id.label: Execution machine
execution_machine_id.note: Each message counts under its own conversation's execution machine, not its work's combined execution machines.

records.label: Message
records.note: A message is one classified user message, placed at the time it was sent.

conversation.label: Conversation
conversation.note: A conversation is one recorded agent conversation; a delegated subagent's conversation is its own. Only its messages in the range count.

work.label: Work
work.note: A work is one workspace's conversations with the delegated work folded into it (work_id), as Human words by workspace counts them; it is not a working directory. Only its messages in the range count.

tokens.label: Tokens
tokens.note: Tokens include cached input and reported reasoning output.

cost.label: API cost (USD)
cost.note: API cost is the list-price equivalent, including assumed and partial prices; unpriced usage has no cost and adds nothing.

priced_cost.label: Fully priced API cost (USD)
priced_cost.note: Only fully priced usage (price_status=priced) is included; assumed, partial and unpriced usage is left out of every measure in this view.

input.label: Input tokens
input.note: Input includes cache reads and cache writes.

cache_read_share.label: Cache-read share of input
cache_read_share.note: Cache reads divided by all input, cache writes included, weighted by tokens rather than averaging per-record percentages.

output_share.label: Output share of tokens
output_share.note: Output tokens divided by all recorded tokens, weighted by tokens.

delegating_share.label: Conversations using delegation
delegating_share.note: Top-level conversations with an active delegated execution divided by all top-level conversations with matching usage. Over time computes each period separately; smoothing averages those period shares.

delegated_share.label: Delegated share of tokens
delegated_share.note: Tokens from delegated runs divided by all matching tokens, grouped by their root conversation when a conversation unit is chosen.

root_conversations.label: Top-level conversations
root_conversations.note: Distinct top-level conversations with matching usage, delegated runs folded into their roots.

conversations.label: Conversations reached
conversations.note: Distinct conversations with usage. A conversation using several groups counts once in each, so groups do not add up to the total.

agent_sessions.label: Agent sessions
agent_sessions.note: Distinct agent sessions with usage. A session using several groups counts once in each.

delegated_runs.label: Delegated runs
delegated_runs.note: Distinct delegated executions with usage; the top-level run is not one. Handles and child transcripts count once.

records.label: Usage record
records.note: A usage record is one agent session’s usage of one model and effort on one recorded day, so record sizes depend on how long sessions ran.

conversation.label: Conversation
conversation.note: A conversation is one top-level conversation including its delegated runs, linked launches and continuations, grouped by its top-level provider, model, effort and repository even where delegated runs used others. Usage with unresolved lineage is left out.

agent_session.label: Agent session
agent_session.note: An agent session is one recorded root agent or subagent session. Model and effort can change within a session, so sessions are not split by them.

repository.label: Top-level repository
repository.note: One repository groups its top-level conversations and their delegated usage in the selected range.

run_effort.label: Run at one effort
run_effort.note: One root run or delegated execution at one effort, with usage in the selected range pooled. A run that changes effort contributes once to each effort used.

delegated_run.label: Delegated run
delegated_run.note: A delegated run is one delegated execution below a top-level conversation, nested and linked launches included, grouped by its top-level conversation’s provider, model, effort and repository.

records.label: Evidence records
records.note: Observed invocations, file loads and harness-reported loads. A load does not prove a skill was followed.

body.label: Retained body volume
body.note: Body volume sums known positive recorded sizes, including repeated loads; evidence without a recorded size is left out.

conversations.label: Conversations reached
conversations.note: Distinct conversations with skill evidence. A conversation with several skills counts once in each, so groups do not add up to the total.

repositories.label: Repositories reached
repositories.note: Distinct repositories holding matching skill evidence; a repository can appear under several skills.

loads.label: Distinct file-load calls
loads.note: Distinct tool calls that loaded a skill file; duplicate evidence for one call counts once.

records.label: Evidence record
records.note: One record is one observed invocation, file load or harness-reported load of a skill.

conversation.label: Conversation
conversation.note: A conversation is one recorded agent conversation with skill evidence; evidence without a conversation is left out.

skill_path.label: Skill path in a conversation
skill_path.note: A skill path in a conversation is the evidence for one skill file in one recorded conversation, so a conversation loading several skills is one observation under each.

time.label: Recorded tool time
time.note: Recorded durations can overlap and may include approval waits. Their sum is tool time, not elapsed wall time.

calls.label: Tool calls
calls.note: Every recorded call counts once, including errors and calls without a duration.

mean_time.label: Mean call duration
mean_time.note: Recorded duration divided by calls with a duration, pooled over each group's calls; calls without timing are left out.

failures.label: Failed calls
failures.note: Calls recorded as errors. A shell command’s non-zero exit can be expected, such as a search with no matches.

failure_rate.label: Failure rate
failure_rate.note: Failed calls divided by all matching calls, pooled over each group.

truncation_rate.label: Truncation rate
truncation_rate.note: Calls with truncated results divided by all matching calls.

conversations.label: Conversations reached
conversations.note: Distinct agent conversations with matching calls; a conversation can appear in several groups.

repositories.label: Repositories reached
repositories.note: Distinct repositories with matching calls; a repository can appear in several groups.

carried_tokens.label: Context carried
carried_tokens.note: Attributed tool-result tokens carried into later requests.

result_tokens.label: Result tokens
result_tokens.note: Tokens a call's result added to the context, measured or estimated from retained result text.

records.label: Tool call
records.note: Calls are placed by their start time and keep their full recorded duration.

conversation.label: Agent conversation
conversation.note: An agent conversation is one recorded agent transcript; delegated subagents are conversations of their own. Calls without a conversation are left out.

path_conversation.label: Path in a conversation
path_conversation.note: Calls to one repository path in one agent conversation form one observation.

tool_conversation.label: Tool in a conversation
tool_conversation.note: A tool in a conversation is one tool's calls in one recorded agent transcript, so a conversation using several tools is one observation under each.

unavailable_views.distribution: These daily tool summaries are summaries, with no value per observation to distribute
unavailable_views.scatter: A scatter pairs two measures of each conversation or run; these daily tool summaries have no such unit
unavailable_views.cycle: These daily tool summaries have no hours or dates to fold into a cycle

calls.label: Calls
calls.note: Call counts show the mix of work agents delegate to tools.

failures.label: Failed calls
failures.note: Calls flagged as errors. A shell command’s non-zero exit can be expected, such as a search with no matches.

failure_rate.label: Failure rate
failure_rate.note: Failed calls divided by all calls, pooled over each group's calls rather than averaging daily rates.

truncation_rate.label: Truncation rate
truncation_rate.note: Calls whose recorded result was truncated, divided by all calls, pooled over each group's calls.

time.label: Recorded tool time
time.note: Summed recorded durations can overlap and include approval waits. Calls without timing contribute no recorded duration.

mean_time.label: Mean timed call duration
mean_time.note: Total recorded duration divided by calls with timing, pooled over each group's calls. Untimed calls are excluded.

context_added.label: Context added
context_added.note: Tokens added by tool results. These are estimates from retained result text.

context_carried.label: Context carried
context_carried.note: Result tokens counted again as later model requests re-read them, until compaction. This measures repeated context consumption.

command_category.label: Command category
command_category.note: Command categories count shell commands only.

program.label: Shell program
program.note: Shell programs count shell commands only.

mcp_server.label: MCP server
mcp_server.note: MCP servers count calls with an identified MCP server only.

mcp_method.label: MCP method
mcp_method.note: MCP methods count calls with a recorded MCP method only.

mcp_server_method.label: MCP server + method
mcp_server_method.note: MCP servers and methods count calls with a recorded MCP method only.

records.label: Daily tool summary
records.note: A daily tool summary is one recorded day's calls of one tool, command, model, repository and origin: a rollup, not one call. Follow a summary's Calls link to its individual calls.

cycles.weekday: These daily tool summaries have no dates to fold
cycles.hour: These daily tool summaries have no time of day to fold

truncation_rate.label: Truncation rate

result_tokens.label: Result tokens

records.label: Tool call
records.note: Calls are placed by their start time and keep their full recorded duration.

conversation.label: Agent conversation
conversation.note: An agent conversation is one recorded agent transcript; delegated subagents are conversations of their own. Calls without a conversation are left out.

path_conversation.label: Path in a conversation
path_conversation.note: Calls to one repository path in one agent conversation form one observation.

tool_conversation.label: Tool in a conversation
tool_conversation.note: A tool in a conversation is one tool's calls in one recorded agent transcript, so a conversation using several tools is one observation under each.

agent_hours.label: Agent hours
agent_hours.note: Agent hours count each active agent's time, so two agents working through one hour are two agent hours.

active_hours.label: Active hours
active_hours.note: Active hours are wall time with any agent active. Each record holds its share of that time (one over the agents active at once), so groups add up to the wall time without counting an hour twice.

parallel_hours.label: Hours with two or more at once
parallel_hours.note: Wall time with two or more agents active at once, shared among them as active hours are.

at_once.label: Agents at once while active
at_once.note: Agent time divided by wall time with any agent active, pooled over each group's records: the time-weighted number of agents working together while any is.

agents.label: Agents
agents.note: Distinct agents (workspaces or top-level sessions, by your counting) active in each group. One active in several groups counts in each.

records.label: Agent hour
records.note: A record is one local hour of one agent at one level of agents active at once.

agent.label: Agent
agent.note: An agent is one workspace, or one top-level session, by your counting setting; its repository and origin are constant.

unavailable_views.scatter: A scatter pairs two measures of each conversation or run; these pharos requests have no such unit

calls.label: Calls
calls.note: Requests served by Pharos's MCP server.

failures.label: Failed calls
failures.note: Requests recorded as errors, disabled, or oversized.

failure_rate.label: Failure rate
failure_rate.note: Failed calls divided by all calls, pooled over each group's requests.

output.label: Estimated output tokens
output.note: Estimated from response size. Response text is not stored.

mean_output.label: Mean output tokens
mean_output.note: Estimated output divided by requests with an estimate, failed calls included, pooled over each group's requests.

largest_output.label: Largest output tokens
largest_output.note: The largest estimated response in each group.

truncated.label: Truncated calls
truncated.note: Requests whose responses were marked truncated.

time.label: Request time
time.note: Recorded server durations. Concurrent requests can overlap, so totals are not elapsed time.

empty_rate.label: Empty-search rate
empty_rate.note: Successful requests that returned no results, divided by successful requests with a recorded result count, pooled over each group's requests. Requests without a count, and failed requests, are left out.

mean_time.label: Mean request duration
mean_time.note: Recorded server duration divided by requests with a duration, pooled over each group's requests.

query_source.label: Requested archive source
query_source.note: The archive source is the caller's explicit source filter; unscoped requests have no recorded source.

records.label: Pharos request
records.note: The latest 5,000 requests are retained, so a long range can hold fewer than were made.

co2.label: Estimated CO₂e (g)
co2.note: Estimated with your Carbon Impact assumptions (estimate range, facility overhead, grid and input sensitivity); token counts are reported, energy and CO₂e are modeled. Models are assigned to size tiers by name; unmatched models use the default tier.

energy.label: Estimated electricity (Wh)
energy.note: Facility electricity: IT energy times facility overhead (PUE). run_effort.label: Run at one effort

delegated_run.label: Delegated run
delegated_run.note: A delegated run is one delegated execution below a top-level conversation, nested and linked launches included, grouped by its top-level conversation’s provider, model, effort and repository.

GroupKey.definition:
/** A field name (group by its exact value) or a calendar key. */
type GroupKey = string | CalendarGroupKey;

ItemPropertyMode.definition:
/** Detail affordances are presentation state, never backend SELECT fields. */
type ItemPropertyMode = "hover" | "modal" | "expand";

RowId.definition:
/** A row's stable identity, used for selection and per-row refresh. */
type RowId = string | number;

WhereBranch.definition:
/** One alternative of an `OrOfAndsGroup`: a literal or a conjunction. */
type WhereBranch = WhereClause | WhereConjunction;
